title: Archaeological retrieval of craft from the ocean floor

tellings.quote: If you're digging something up under, you know, tens of meters of of sediment deposited on the ocean floor, like that takes time to build up.

plain: Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower, describes craft being dug up from the ocean floor like an archaeological dig. He points out that something buried under tens of meters of sediment must have been lying there a very long time, since that much sediment takes ages to build up, which would mean the craft are very old.
